title: explorer-verify request
description: The whole request of the CLI's verify or status command as one JSON document, passed with --input-json <file|-> (R-AX-16). A verify request is a VerifyInput, as validateInput() checks it, with an optional route. A status request is a handle with an optional route. No field holds an API key or an RPC URL: give keys through the environment, --api-key-file or --api-key-stdin, and the RPC URL of verify through --rpc-url-file, --rpc-url-stdin or --rpc-url. The CLI refuses unknown properties with one invalid-input issue that counts them and never names them.

verify.description: The request of explorer-verify verify: a VerifyInput and an optional route.

chainId.description: EVM chain id the contract is deployed on.

compiler.description: The compiler, its full version and the Standard JSON input of the deployment.

version.description: The full solc version with its commit, such as 0.8.24+commit.e11b9ed9.

input.description: The Standard JSON input. Fields other than language, sources and settings pass through to the explorer.

contractName.description: The fully qualified contract name, path:Name.

constructorArgs.description: ABI-encoded constructor arguments, without the selector.

creationTxHash.description: The hash of the creation transaction.

creationBytecode.description: The compiled creation bytecode, the compiler's evm.bytecode.object, with or without 0x, library placeholders included. Used only to derive missing constructorArgs; never sent to an explorer.

libraries.description: Library link addresses by the library's fully qualified name, path:Name.

status.description: The request of explorer-verify status: a handle and an optional route.

handle.description: The handle in its one-line form, ev1:<backend>:<chainId>:<address>:<jobId>.

route.description: The route override, as --backend and --api-url give it. It holds no key.

backend.description: A backend name. Known values in this release: etherscan-v2, etherscan-compatible, blockscout, sourcify, routescan.

apiUrl.description: The explorer API URL: https, or http on localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1].
